Operon D860

Surgical table

text_copy_copy_copy__1314303255.text:
Operon D860

From general surgery to orthopaedics, the Operon D860 is designed to meet the needs of a variety of surgical disciplines. A full line of accessories allows you to customize your surgical table while delivering the versatility and productivity that your surgical suite demands.

text_copy_copy_copy_.text:
1,000 lbs

Weight capacity at full articulation in normal articulation

22.6"-46.4"

Vertical travel range

16.9"

Longitudinal slide for superior imaging access

100+

Accessories to support a broad range of procedures

text_copy.text:
Exceptional vertical range 

With a vertical travel range of 22.6" to 46.4", the Operon D860 easily adjusts to the desired working level, helping accommodate a variety of procedures, positioning requirements and clinician preferences.

text_copy_copy_copy__601011597.text:
A table that adapts to your needs. 

The Operon D860 can be configured to support a broad range of surgical procedures through a comprehensive portfolio of accessories and positioning solutions. From bariatric and urology to gynecology, vascular, neurosurgery, general surgery and orthopaedics, the D860 provides the flexibility to adapt across specialties.

standaloneimage.alt: D860 provides the flexibility to adapt to different specialties

text_copy_copy_copy_.text: Click on the tabs to learn more

Urology

Supports lithotomy positioning and imaging access for procedures such as urology and cystoscopy, with accessories designed to improve access and support patient positioning.

Lightweight leg transfer board

Supports the patient’s legs before and after lithotomy positioning.

Premium lightweight comfort stirrups, 350 lb pair

Supports the patient’s legs in lithotomy while providing pelvic access and adjustable positioning. Additional stirrup options available.

Clean catcher drainage bag, sterile, disposable

Provides a disposable drainage solution for urology and cystoscopy procedures.

General Surgery

Supports a range of general surgery procedures with flexible positioning options, including lateral, flex, jackknife and split leg configurations.

Carbon fiber trigger armboard

Attaches directly to the side rail and provides radiolucent support for the patient’s arm.

Split legs, pair

Attach to the table and independently articulate to support flexible leg positioning.

text_copy_copy_copy__1252567971.text:
Bariatric width extender set

Expands the table surface on both sides to better accommodate larger patients.

text_copy_copy_copy_.text:
Lateral positioning set

Helps stabilize the patient during lateral procedures with adjustable positioning supports.

Imaging

Provides flexible imaging access with configurable imaging extensions and table positioning designed to support lower body and vascular procedures.

36 inch imaging extension, carbon fiber

Attaches in place of the back or leg section to provide radiolucent imaging access.

44 inch imaging extension, carbon fiber

Attaches in place of the back or leg section to provide extended radiolucent imaging access.

text_copy_copy_copy__1252567971.text:
Imaging extension rail clamp

Adds side rail space to the imaging extension so arm boards or other rail mounted accessories can be attached.

text_copy_copy_copy_.text:
X-ray cassette tray

Slides into the Operon table’s integrated X-ray cassette channel to securely hold film and support complete body imaging.

Neurology

Supports cranial and neurosurgical procedures with positioning solutions designed to provide head support, fixation and surgical access.

Neuro adapter bar, low profile

Attaches to the table and provides an interface for commonly used neurosurgical headrests and fixation systems.

DORO® QR3 headrest system, aluminum

Provides secure head positioning and supports attachment of accessories such as navigation sensors or retractor systems.

DORO® horseshoe headrest, aluminum

Supports the patient’s head in supine or prone positioning with vertical and lateral adjustability.

Orthopaedics

Supports shoulder procedures with the beach chair position, providing flexible patient positioning and access throughout the procedure.

Integrated shoulder chair

Attaches to the table to support beach chair positioning for shoulder procedures.

Swivel, armboard

Provides adjustable arm positioning with a ball joint for a wide range of movement and flexibility.

Disposable face mask, pack of 12

Secures the patient’s head during beach chair positioning.

Bariatric

Supports positioning of larger patients with accessories designed to expand the table surface, provide additional support, and accommodate higher weight capacities. The table supports a 1,250 lb patient weight capacity at center, helping meet the demands of bariatric procedures while maintaining stability and patient access.

Armboard, bariatric

Provides wider arm support with an integrated clamp and a 1,000 lb weight capacity.

Bariatric leg and body strap

Provides extra wide, padded support to help secure larger patients.

text_copy_copy_copy__1252567971.text:
Premium bariatric comfort stirrups, 800 lb

Supports lithotomy positioning for larger patients while providing pelvic access.

text_copy_copy_copy_.text:
Bariatric width extender set

Expands the full length of the table surface on both sides to accommodate larger patients.
